description:
Non-Material Amendment to planning permission ref: P2020/3548/FUL: 'Single storey vertical extension to the existing building to provide additional (Class E) office accommodation, infill of the inset to Wilson Street at 1st - 4th floors to provide additional floorspace, 
alterations to the existing facades, installation of new rooftop plant and associated works'. The proposed amendments include:
• Change the metal cladding/fenestration finish from anodised bronze aluminium to PPC metallic bronze aluminium.   
• Change the stone cladding finish from Portland Stone to reconstituted stone to match existing reconstituted stone 
colour and finish.  
• Change from render to PPC aluminium colour matched to the existing Portland Stone on the western elevation. 
• Change proposed glass balustrade within the lightwell to retain the existing metal balustrade.  
• Refinement of the party-wall finish from render to light-coloured facing brickwork to align more closely with the 
existing limestone.   
• Alterations to door sizes at ground floor level on the Wilson Street façade 
• Additional louvres above the doors on the Wilson Street façade to support ventilation and servicing requirements.  
• Additional louvres to WC core to support ventilation and servicing requirements.  
• Alteration to door size on level 7 terrace and associated redistribution of fins to improve access and coordinate 
with the internal layout.  
• Introduction of terrace landscaping strategy at first, fifth, sixth and seventh floor levels to enhance biodiversity.  
• Introduction of low-level tenant plant above the WC core to support future tenants servicing requirements.  
• Introduction of key-clamp guarding to provide safer access for maintenance.  
• Introduction of monorail and support structure for lightwell cleaning and maintenance
